source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Kamsi if its the order matches Organic's rule (see below) AND contains one of Kamsi's owned product IDs, EXCLUDING any Direct order whose 2nd session is Google Ads paid search (those go to Sajeepan/Sonya instead, checked earlier — per user request 2026-07-30, "pure organic" Direct only). Checked before Organic and Dilaksi.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Kamsi -> Dilaksi -> Organic) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. 2025 backfill using the exact same rules already confirmed on salesuk.html for 2026 — built 2026-07-29.
